correctness.rationale: With offsets s=b−a and t=c−a, put u=z+z⁻¹. The Laurent ring is free over F₂[u] on (1,z), by the quadratic identity for z and inversion symmetry. The determinant of columns zⁱ,zʲ is P_|j−i|/u, so every two-site system is independent. In the Laurent ring the gcd of z⁻ˢ(z²ˢ+1) and z⁻ᵗ(z²ᵗ+1) is, up to units, z⁻ᵍ(z²ᵍ+1); divisibility by a member of F₂[u] descends by the free basis. Dividing the minors by their gcd gives the primitive vector (P_(t−s),P_t,P_s)/P_g. Bézout forces every polynomial syzygy to be its polynomial multiple. The maximum component degree is h=t−g, so the dependencies for length n are precisely the multiples of degrees 0 through n−1−h, with none if n≤h. Fair iid input is uniform on each linear observation image, giving the pairwise independence and entropy statements. All parity-admissible prefixes lie in their observation images; nested compact preimages realize the entire trace. Since every block of length at most h is allowed, but not every length h+1 block is, memory h is sharp.
residual_risks: The bounded independent rank check corroborates only its tested spacings and time lengths; the general result follows from the proof. Bernoulli fairness is needed for the asserted uniform probability law.
